verdict: Ads are delivering, but spend efficiency dipped and milestones need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated 35 purchases and $6,648.81 in revenue at a 4.43x return on ad spend — still above the target floor, but spend climbed 51% week-over-week and revenue per dollar hasn't kept pace, compressing efficiency. Purchase volume is trending in the right direction, with September 8th posting your strongest single-day revenue in the recent run. Your Google Business Profile actions have gone dark for nine consecutive days, and we're actively investigating the cause. Separately, five planned milestones from August are overdue; we're working through those now to keep the September 30th deliverables on track.
